title: The Rams’ toughest opponent may be themselves ‘iron sharpens iron’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The Rams’ toughest opponent may be themselves ‘iron sharpens iron’
sources.description: Matthew Stafford and the Rams’ elite offense face Myles Garrett, Trent McDuffie and a revamped defense every day in training camp, preparing both units for the season.
